steps: Releases are installed and upgraded with the arguments of Dockflow's Helm backend (helmUpgradeArgs: values on stdin, --rollback-on-failure, --wait=watcher, --history-max 5, labels stack/role/spec-hash), from chart archives pulled from the e2e chart repository
upgrade of web to e2e-broken 0.1.0 with --timeout 60s: it fails and --rollback-on-failure rolls it back (revisions superseded, failed, deployed)

upgrade-stderr.txt: stderr of helm upgrade --install web /tmp/dockflow-fixture-charts/e2e-broken-0.1.0.tgz -n fixture-helm-history-rollback --values - --reset-values --rollback-on-failure --wait=watcher --wait-for-jobs --timeout 60s --history-max 5 --force-conflicts --description 'Dockflow 0.0.0-dev' --labels dockflow.shawiizz.dev/stack=fixture-helm-history-rollback,dockflow.shawiizz.dev/role=app,dockflow.shawiizz.dev/spec-hash=212ba3d1b44776fda370f90d6e853be3
history.json: helm history web -n fixture-helm-history-rollback --max 20 -o json
release-secrets.txt: kubectl get secrets -n fixture-helm-history-rollback -l owner=helm,name=web -o name
